## About
Exhaust Authority is an exhaust shop with a full-service automotive garage on K Avenue in Plano. We build and repair exhaust systems for autos, light trucks and SUVs, and we keep plenty of parts on hand to get the job done.
Classics are a regular sight in our front lot, and we've earned a good reputation with the classics community. We work on newer cars and trucks just the same.
We're rated 4.7 from 192 Google reviews. Reviewers have written that we didn't try to sell them work they didn't need, and that's how we like to do business.

## Services
- Performance exhaust systems: Performance exhaust systems for autos, light trucks and SUVs.
- Converter anti-theft cages: Cages that help protect your catalytic converter, fitted to autos, light trucks and SUVs.
- Piping that fits: When a system doesn't fit right, we can fab up piping that does. One reviewer brought in a system with clearance issues and leaks, and we made it fit.
- Exhaust tips: A big selection of exhaust tips to finish off your system.
- Flowmaster, Dynomax, Magnaflow, Borla and FloPro exhaust products: We're a full line dealer for these exhaust brands.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on classic cars?
A: Yes. Classics are a regular sight at our shop, and we work on newer vehicles too.

Q: Which exhaust brands do you carry?
A: We're a full line dealer for Flowmaster, Dynomax, Magnaflow, Borla and FloPro exhaust products.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday mornings from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.
